statements.t: Seaboard evaluates its overall liquidity at least quarterly, and management believes that Seaboard’s internally-generated cash, together with its available liquidity and borrowing capacity, will be adequate to meet all of its short-term and long-term commitments.
Management anticipates funding these capital expenditures through a combination of available cash, proceeds from sales of short-term investments and Seaboard’s available borrowing capacity.
